scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts Equis out/equis-demo.mp4 --browser-executable "/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" --codec h264 --crf 14 --x264-preset slow --image-format png --pixel-format yuv420p --color-space bt709 --audio-codec aac --audio-bitrate 320k --overwrite && node scripts/finish.mjs out/equis-demo.mp4
